remarks: Discover a rare blend of historic charm, modern design, and sustainable living at 401 Wildwood Road - a fully restored 5-bedroom, 3-bath designer home set on a private, one-acre hilltop with mature landscaping and sweeping woodland views. The property backs onto four unbuildable acres, creating a serene, parklike "treehouse" setting. Originally built in 1926 and completely updated between 2015-2025, this move-in ready home combines eco-friendly technology with timeless architectural character. Features include a chef's kitchen with highend appliances, radiant heated stone floors, vaulted family and great rooms, a greenhouse with waterfall, fenced yard, and expansive deck - perfect for entertaining or quiet relaxation.  Enjoy Nest thermostats, security cameras, Level 2 EV charging, and a 45-panel solar system with on demand hot water for exceptional energy efficiency and low operating costs. Located in one of North Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods, this peaceful retreat offers both privacy and community. Children play safely on wide lawns, neighbors stroll along quiet, tree-lined streets, and professionals enjoy an easy commute - less than 20 minutes to Stamford or Greenwich train stations, and about 45 mins to Times Square.
